chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Barqi, from Aban, from al-Halbi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
There is no problem with the dung of donkeys, and wash its urine.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no problem / It is permissible / It is pure

ai.seo_question: Is the dung of donkeys considered pure or impure in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the fiqh of animal excreta by distinguishing between the dung and urine of donkeys, ruling the former as pure (tahir) and the latter as impure (najis) requiring washing. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it aligns with the general principle that the waste of animals with edible meat is pure, while that of non-edible animals like donkeys is impure, reflecting the practical purification methods emphasized in the Imams' teachings.
